records.rationale: The finding correctly identifies that in the `add_members` method (lines 55-68), when iterating through usernames with `usernames.split(",").each do |username|`, if `User.find_by_username(username)` returns nil (user doesn't exist), the code silently skips that username with the `if user = ...` conditional. After the loop, if `group.save` succeeds, it renders `success_json` without any indication of which usernames were actually added vs skipped. This is a real behavioral issue where partial failures are silently ignored and reported as complete success.
